briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Doors Open, Deals Close: Michigan Storefronts Expand as National M&A and Psilocybin Momentum Build
briefs.top: Michigan operators are opening new doors and betting on tax relief at the ballot box even as the 24% wholesale tax bites, while nationally Curaleaf's $270M Aurora bid and Compass Pathways' on-track FDA filing show real capital and science moving the industry forward. The DEA hit a procedural speed bump on rescheduling, but pressure from the White House and a booming state tax base keep the bigger trend pointed up.
